strategy.summary: The todo app (public/app.js) lets users tick todos complete, filter by All/Active/Completed (aria-pressed on the selected button) and clear completed todos. State lives in browser memory per page load, so each Playwright test starts from an empty list and adds its own todos. The tests prove the strike-through and count change, each filter's contents and pressed state, and the visibility and effect of "Clear completed".
inScope: Completing/uncompleting a todo via its checkbox: strike-through and items-left count
All / Active / Completed filters: listed todos and aria-pressed state
Clear completed: visibility rule and removal of every completed todo
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only)
assumptions: No backend: server.js only serves static files, so nothing is faked; Playwright's existing webServer starts the real server.
Todos are held in page memory, so every test gets an empty list on page.goto('/') and creates its own data; no cleanup needed.
'Struck through' is checked as the todo text's computed text-decoration-line being line-through (styles.css: li.completed span).
Absence assertions are made with exact list contents (toHaveText on the whole list), which wait for the expected items to render.

risks.description: Count text or pluralisation regressions ('1 item left' vs '2 items left')
risks.mitigation: Assert exact count text before and after ticking/unticking

risks.description: Filter shows wrong todos or wrong pressed state
risks.mitigation: Each filter tested with a mix of completed and active todos, asserting the exact list and aria-pressed of all three buttons

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or only one completed todo
risks.mitigation: Clear with two completed and one active todo, assert exact remaining list

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed (struck through) and lowers the items-left count by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only uncompleted todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is shown only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and lowers the items left count
preconditions: Fresh page with todos 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog' added
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is checked, its text has text-decoration-line line-through, 'Walk dog' is not struck through, count reads '1 item left' (was '2 items left')

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the count
preconditions: Fresh page with 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog', 'Buy milk' ticked ('1 item left')
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, text-decoration-line none, count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only uncompleted todos and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Walk dog' ticked
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Walk dog' ticked
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed aria-pressed=true, All and Active false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Walk dog' ticked; Completed filter selected
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent']; All aria-pressed=true, Active and Completed false
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent

testCases.title: Clear completed is shown only while a todo is completed
testCases.expected: Hidden with no completed todo, visible after ticking, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: Refusal case: the action is unavailable when there is nothing to clear

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent' ticked
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog'], count '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent
testCases.rationale: Removes all completed, not just one, and never active ones

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer in playwright.config.js starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173). Chromium must be installed. No seed data or env vars.
